provenance.what: ERA5 hazard fits computed with the live code path (tools/climatology.py), served before the archive request for the listed cities
provenance.attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com/). ERA5: Hersbach, H. et al. (2023), ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present, ECMWF, https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.adbb2d47. Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information.
provenance.changes: daily series reduced to annual maxima and fitted with a GEV (tools/hazard_stats.py, tools/gev_trend.py)

value.statistic_definition: annual maximum of ERA5 daily-maximum 2 m air temperature
value.interpretation: Point-interpolated ERA5 daily-max temperature (~25 km); captures the diurnal peak at the requested location but is not bias-corrected to a station, so it may modestly under-represent a true local extreme in heterogeneous terrain.
